title: Serve one candidate population to the roster, the matrix and the retire dialog
tests_added: app/features/tools/profile/candidateMatrixContracts.test.ts (+4 cases, mutation-proved incl. the tenancy pin)
deviations_from_card: (1) routedCount matches the NORMALIZED archetype id, not archetypeDisplayKey as the card's case 4 says. Only non-built-in archetypes can be retired (canArchive = !BUILT_IN), the bundled archetypes.json holds only bau/student/career_switcher, and archetypeDisplayKey folds every id the bundle does not know into 'unrouted', so a display-key match would count 0 for every archetype the dialog serves. The case's intent is kept: the unrouted sentinels ('', 'unknown', 'unrouted') never count, which is pinned. (2) The store-record -> population mappers (profileFromRecord / analysisFromRecord) moved from the route into candidate-population.ts so the family-parity case tests the real server mapping rather than a copy. (3) The tenancy pin is a mutation-proved source guard in candidateMatrixContracts.test.ts (currentWorkspace() + listAnalysisRecords(200, ws) + cachedProfileRecords(ws) + profileStaleness(ws)); no new route test file. (4) The hook takes {active}: ProfileTab stays mounted under the editor, so the one read pauses while the editor is open and re-reads when it closes (before, the projections remounted and refetched). (5) perf-budget.json (shared surface, under lock) raised by this card's measured share only. 13 test cases for the card's 6 acceptance lines (all 6 covered).
notes: Committed in five commits: catalog key (archiveConfirmAnalyses, 4 locales), doc, perf budget, test+pure fold, then the component refactor.
